activation: explicit selection by the consuming project only
composition: one selected profile per investigation; distinct subinvestigations may use different profiles with explicit handoffs
external_execution: optional existing authorised tools only; no automatic install, network call or job
pack_root_rules: relative paths resolve inside the selected pack root
reject absolute paths, traversal and external symlinks
do not include private project evidence
purpose: Research a bounded scholarly question with explicit work/report/version units and method-specific appraisal.

method_sources.scope: Method principles and limits; no automatic external acquisition.

source ecology.rationale: Use appropriate scholarly identifiers, author/publisher originals and available status records; a supplied-paper task need not search every database.

search strategy.rationale: Expand terms and citation paths only within the brief; record search coverage and distinguish a focused check from systematic conduct.

inclusion / exclusion rules.rationale: Declare eligibility by question and study/design; retain eligible adverse/null findings and separate unavailable full text from exclusion.

source appraisal.rationale: Appraise the actual design, metrics and transfer limits. Do not apply clinical risk-of-bias tools indiscriminately to computing benchmarks.

research methods.rationale: Link reports/versions to the underlying work or study and reconcile changed populations/configurations before synthesis.

synthesis structure.rationale: Present question-to-finding support with unit linkage, method limits and unresolved applicability separately.

quality criteria.rationale: Check support, status, report linkage, appropriate counting, uncertainty and claims about completeness; no universal score.

reporting conventions.rationale: Use exact work/version locators and identify the review type actually performed. Reporting checklists cannot certify unperformed conduct.

effects.change: Specify scholarly units, eligibility and an appropriate appraisal method before retrieval.
effects.observable: Plan states which report/study/version is counted and which inference is authorised.

effects.change: Resolve relevant scholarly identities and status within the allowed corpus.
effects.observable: Search/selection record differentiates candidate, eligible, unavailable and superseded representation.

effects.change: Capture method, task/population, measure, units and locators needed for the finding.
effects.observable: No abstract-only record supplies unseen methods.

effects.change: Link multiple reports and revisions before counting or comparing; appraise threshold transfer.
effects.observable: A revised paper cannot become another independent experiment.

effects.change: Expose design limits and study/report structure; keep implications conditional.
effects.observable: A benchmark threshold is not rendered as universal application acceptance.

effects.change: Check the relevant correction/revision and repair affected claims without silently repointing historical evidence.
effects.observable: Unchanged prior findings retain their basis.

effects.change: Add report-linkage, status-boundary and method-transfer checks to applicable core dimensions.
effects.observable: Bibliographic validity and substantive support receive separate verdicts.

showcase.expected_change: Version-linked unit counting and design-specific threshold applicability, with preserved core findings.

evaluation.required: Core invariants and all applicable specialist criteria; actual bounded core/pack pair and negative behaviour checks.
